speaker: (the reaper)
text: You need not slow down. I am only saying it to the road.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Say it, then. I did not ask.

speaker: (the reaper)
text: Two for one where it should be four. And the maltsters'll have it before it's dry.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two for one, where it should be four. I have heard you. I am not buying it.

speaker: (the reaper)
text: I am not selling. I am binding what came up. They will have the rest for the steep.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then bind it. I have no figure to give you back.
